title: Make observlib-rs available as an Abscissa component
description:
Integrate observlib-rs with the Abscissa framework as a reusable component. This will allow Abscissa applications to easily initialize OpenTelemetry observability with minimal configuration.

Goals:
- Create an Abscissa component that wraps observlib initialization
- Support configuration through Abscissa's config system
- Provide lifecycle hooks for proper startup and shutdown
- Document usage patterns for Abscissa applications
- Ensure compatibility with Abscissa's tracing integration
